# CloudBee Robotics

The Capability Factory for Agentic Physical AI.

CloudBee Robotics builds the Capability Engineering Platform for Physical AI.
We transform industrial processes into validated capabilities, generate
multimodal synthetic experience, train foundation models, and deploy
self-improving autonomous systems for warehousing, manufacturing and
industrial automation.

Domain: https://cloudbeerobotics.de
Location: Aachen, Germany
Contact: info@cloudbeerobotics.de

## Platform

- Capability Compiler - turns industrial processes, demonstrations,
  teleoperation, images, panoramas and videos into Process Graphs,
  Capability Graphs, Task Graphs, Scene Graphs, World Models, Safety
  Graphs, Validation Graphs and Autonomous Workflows.
- Safety & Validation Engine - generates validation scenarios, safety
  constraints, failure modes, recovery paths, compliance rules and
  safety audits before training begins. EU AI Act aligned.
- Synthetic Experience Engine - generates training-ready multimodal
  experience (RGB, Depth, LiDAR, Segmentation, Actions, Rewards,
  Trajectories, World States, Failure Cases, Recovery Cases) from
  text, panoramas, demonstration videos and teleoperation.
- ModelLab - trains Vision-Language-Action models, World Models, RL
  Policies, IL Policies and Reward Models on combined real and
  synthetic experience.
- Autonomous OS - recursively self-correcting runtime that plans,
  executes, verifies, recovers and learns. Supports robots, AI
  agents and human operators. Hardware-agnostic via ROS2; supports
  Universal Robots cobots, Franka arms and Unitree G1.

## Focus

- Warehouse: picking, sorting, palletizing, depalletizing, container unloading.
- Industrial automation: assembly, welding, soldering, inspection,
  packaging, material handling.

## Moat

Every deployment contributes process knowledge, failure modes, recovery
strategies, validation results, safety audits and execution intelligence
to a compounding capability graph - Capability Intelligence, Safety
Intelligence, Validation Intelligence and Execution Intelligence.

## Backed by

EXIST Gründerstipendium (German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs),
RWTH Aachen Innovation, RWTH International Academy, Collective Incubator
Aachen, IGMR (RWTH Mechanism Theory).
